objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Use Pikachu's RCE section to run a command on the web server and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The RCE entry of the left menu has a page that pings an address for you.
The address goes to a shell command as is: what happens to whatever follows a command separator?

steps.title: Find the page
steps.prompt: Which page of the RCE section runs a network tool with your input? (its file name)

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which form parameter carries the address to that command?

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets your input run a command of your own on the server?
